prompt_en: Photograph a complex soil-centered scene at the working end of a long cylindrical nursery aboard a future generation ship, just as the first distant sunrise reaches its forward observation window. A human subject guided by the supplied portrait's face and hair is tending a damaged planting bed. Her rounded oval face, large dark eyes, small softly rounded nose and pink lips retain the reference's appearance; her chin-length dark brown bob curves inward, with fine wispy bangs across her forehead. Her face is turned in a readable three-quarter view as she studies the water beside her hands, lips slightly parted and warm light across one cheek. A fitted sage sleeveless knit top and practical charcoal trousers give her a quiet, tactile human presence within the cool industrial space. The soil itself carries the visible event. A loose condensate hose at the far edge of the bed is discharging a thin stream into a newly eroded shallow rill. Its water has drawn fine pale sediment away from dark brown, crumbly loam and exposed a few roots of one small seedling. The woman kneels on the firm maintenance walkway beside the waist-wide bed, both knees supported, leaning only as far as her elbows can comfortably reach. Her right fingertips press a low ridge of wet ochre clay into the short breach between the damaged rill and the normal drainage channel. The clay holds smooth finger impressions and a coherent rounded edge; water curls around that edge and flows into the channel. Her left palm cups loose loam against the seedling's rootball beside the ridge, leaving distinct small earthy crumbs caught between roots and fingers. The breach exposes a short upright soil face just below the seedling: one thicker root runs from the seedling's stem base through that face, branching into finer offshoots still embedded in damp brown grains. Her cupped left hand rebuilds loose soil against the lower half of this face, leaving the upper root-to-stem junction readable. The redirected water leaves a shallow pale sediment fan immediately downstream. Moist intact soil around the plant, fresh clay hand marks, the washed groove and the sediment fan remain visibly connected across this one small working area. Show her head, torso, knees, both hands and the near soil edge in a landscape environmental photograph from the adjoining walkway. Keep her face and the material contacts readable in the same focal zone. The repeating ribs and successive planted beds recede far down the immense cylindrical chamber; the forward window carries a restrained sliver of orange sunrise above a planet's curved horizon. Soft practical nursery light and the distant warm beam separate dark loam, ochre cohesive clay, pale sediment and natural skin. Use restrained documentary color, plausible gravity and fine photographic surface detail.
